about.title: About
about.body: Kaheel is an online marketplace for services, contracting, suppliers, equipment and real estate. Any registered user can publish as an individual or under a store, and buyers can browse, search and message advertisers directly.

help.title: Help
help.body: To publish: create an account, choose "Post a listing", then fill in the category, title, price, city and images. A listing runs for seven days and can be renewed. To reach an advertiser, use the message button on the listing page.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body: By using the platform you agree to publish accurate information, to avoid content that breaks the law, and that each listing is the responsibility of its publisher. The platform may review or suspend any listing that breaches these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We collect the data needed to run your account, publish listings and enable contact between parties. Private contact details are not shown inside public listings, and your data is not shared with third parties for marketing.

contact.title: Contact the platform team
contact.body: For any question or to report a listing, use the report button on the listing page or write to us at:
